message.content:
This editorial illustration shows the cover of Tempo magazine, dated "25-31 MEI 2015". Two men in shirts and trousers physically struggle with a large, rusted brown metal oil drum. One man, wearing glasses, leans forward from the left, gripping the top rim. The other man, on the right, leans back with his head tilted upward, supporting the drum’s side. The drum is tilted diagonally and features two white horizontal bands. 

Unusually, numerous dark, tangled roots emerge from the open bottom of the drum, spreading across the light blue ground. The background is a solid light blue with a red vertical border on the left. At the top, white text reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" and "JALAN POS DAENDELS," flanking a small circular portrait of a man in historical military attire. The large title "TEMPO" is in black, while "BEDOL PETRAL" is in large white block letters. Smaller Indonesian text is printed below the title. A barcode, the price "RP 39.500", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are located in the bottom right corner.
